messages:
Liam: Heads-up — QuietBay procurement reached out about POC sign-off. They need the signed order form, PO, and exact DocuSign routing. Any open items on MSA/DPA redlines?
Anya: I reviewed their redlines. They added an HSM attestation requirement and changed terms to Net60. Legal won't accept a hard HSM warranty; propose 'reasonable commercial efforts' language and provide our attestation doc instead.
Oliver: On the technical side they want a short-term latency commitment for the trial so infra can approve. Suggest adding a POC appendix with non-binding targets measured in the Console. Avoid touching the MSA.
Marie: Finance flags Net60 as a problem. We can offer Net30 or 30% prepayment + Net30. If they insist on Net60, we need RevOps approval.
Liam: Procurement also says they require a PO before countersign and want the DocuSign flow to include a PO field and route by tax ID. Do we have a sanitized KMS/HSM attestation PDF ready?
Anya: Yes — KMS summary and SOC2 bundle available. I'll generate a redacted attestation PDF for them. Legal's recommended phrasing: replace any HSM guarantee with attestation + "reasonable commercial efforts" clause.
Oliver: Proposed POC appendix text (draft): ```Temporary POC appendix: Targets (via Redwood Console) — p50 < 150ms, p95 < 500ms for seq_len <= 1024 on provisioned trial capacity. Metrics visible in per-route latency dashboard. Appendix is informational and non-binding for the trial period.```
Anya: Tiny tweak: change "provisioned trial capacity" -> "provisioned trial capacity subject to availability" to limit guarantees.
Liam: Good call. Also QuietBay asked about EU data residency for logs and SOC2 evidence. We can enable region pinning to eu-west-1 for the trial and apply log redaction. Need engineering to flip the flags.
DevBot: Uploaded attestations: /shared/attestations/redwood-kms-summary.pdf and SOC2.zip
Jake: For routing they want: QuietBay legal -> QuietBay exec -> QuietBay procurement -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood RevOps. Envelope must include PO number and billing contact fields. Any concerns?
Anya: That routing is acceptable. Use redwood-esign@redwood.com for internal recipients. Remove internal schedules before sending.
Marie: Reminder: if they pick Net60 without prepay, Finance will hold payment and require approval. Ask for billing contact and PO up front.
Liam: I'll send QuietBay: updated order form offering Net30 or 30% prepay + Net30, attached POC appendix (with availability wording), KMS attestation link, SOC2 link, and the proposed DocuSign routing steps. Also request billing contact + PO number.
Oliver: I'll attach the finalized appendix to the order form before you send.
Anya: Once uploaded I'll run a quick redline pass. Please strip any internal-only exhibits.
Liam: Sending now. Will update thread when they reply. Thanks :thumbsup:
